do-not-merge.name: Do not merge (claws out)
do-not-merge.description: Hold the merge until a maintainer removes this label.

needs-work.name: Needs work (back to the basket)
needs-work.description: Changes are still needed before this pull request can merge.

needs-testing.name: Needs testing (paw check)
needs-testing.description: The behaviour in this pull request still needs checking.

waiting-on-upstream.name: Waiting on upstream (catnap)
waiting-on-upstream.description: Blocked on a change outside Neconyan.

breaking-change.name: Breaking change (hiss)
breaking-change.description: Hold for review of a change that can break existing setups.

feature-request.name: Feature request (wish list)
feature-request.description: Suggest a new feature or improvement.

duplicate.name: Duplicate (copycat)
duplicate.description: Another issue or pull request already covers this.

new-feature.name: New feature (kitten)
new-feature.description: Historical label for pull requests that introduced a feature.

refactor.name: Refactor (tidy den)
refactor.description: Reorganises code without changing what it does.

performance.name: Performance (zoomies)
performance.description: Makes something faster or reduces resource use.

size-xs.name: Size XS (toe bean)
size-xs.description: 20 changed lines or fewer, excluding lockfiles and vendored libraries.

size-s.name: Size S (kitten)
size-s.description: 21 to 100 changed lines, excluding lockfiles and vendored libraries.

size-m.name: Size M (house cat)
size-m.description: 101 to 500 changed lines, excluding lockfiles and vendored libraries.

size-l.name: Size L (Maine Coon)
size-l.description: 501 to 1,000 changed lines, excluding lockfiles and vendored libraries.

size-xl.name: Size XL (big cat)
size-xl.description: Over 1,000 changed lines, excluding lockfiles and vendored libraries.

merge-conflict.name: Merge conflict (tangled yarn)
merge-conflict.description: Resolve conflicts with the target branch before merging.

done-staging.name: Done in staging (paw stamp)
done-staging.description: Merged into staging, not yet in a published release.

high-priority.name: High priority (tail up)
high-priority.description: Needs attention ahead of routine work.

good-first-issue.name: Good first issue (kitten step)
good-first-issue.description: A place to start contributing to Neconyan.

invalid.name: Invalid report (wrong box)
invalid.description: The report is missing what we need to act on it.

wontfix.name: Won't fix (paws off)
wontfix.description: Maintainers don't plan to implement this.

out-of-scope.name: Out of scope (not our box)
out-of-scope.description: This falls outside the scope of Neconyan.

spam.name: Spam (hiss)
spam.description: Spam. Closes and locks the issue.

stale.name: Stale (catnap)
stale.description: No recent activity. The thread may close automatically.

keep-open.name: Keep open (stay put)
keep-open.description: Exempt from the automatic inactivity close.

awaiting-reply.name: Awaiting reply (ears up)
awaiting-reply.description: Waiting for the person who opened the issue to reply.

alternative-exists.name: Alternative exists (side door)
alternative-exists.description: A different solution is available for this issue.

conversation.name: Conversation (cat chat)
conversation.description: Conversation mode and its chat workspace.

meower.name: Meower (mrrp)
meower.description: Meower, its feed and native store.

quick-image-gen.name: Quick Image Gen (pawtraits)
quick-image-gen.description: The Quick Image Gen workspace and its image providers.

phone-layout.name: Phone layout (pocket cat)
phone-layout.description: Touch controls, phone navigation and layout.

themes.name: Themes (many coats)
themes.description: Themes, Shell Styles, accents and contrast.

android-app.name: Android app (green paws)
android-app.description: The standalone Android app and its builds.

iphone-app.name: iPhone app (pocket paws)
iphone-app.description: The standalone iPhone app and its builds.

ci.name: CI (night watch)
ci.description: GitHub checks, release tools and test automation.

handbook.name: Handbook (field notes)
handbook.description: Handbook links, in-app help and assistant knowledge.

docker.name: Docker (cat in a box)
docker.description: Reported on Docker or related to its packaging.
